arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import numpy as np

# Data
x = np.array([2010, 2011, 2012])
y = np.array([1293454, 1295591, 1089353])

# OLS regression
n = len(x)
x_mean = np.mean(x)
y_mean = np.mean(y)

# Calculate slope and intercept
numerator = np.sum((x - x_mean) * (y - y_mean))
denominator = np.sum((x - x_mean)**2)
slope = numerator / denominator
intercept = y_mean - slope * x_mean

# Predict for 2013
x_2013 = 2013
y_pred = slope * x_2013 + intercept

print(f"Slope: {slope}")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept}")
print(f"Predicted financing for 2013: {y_pred}")
print(f"Rounded to 2 decimal places: {round(y_pred, 2)}")
EOF
